dishes.name: Truffade
dishes.desc: Sliced potatoes cooked with garlic and fresh tomme cheese until stringy, served with local ham and salad. The emblematic dish of Auvergne.

dishes.name: Pounti
dishes.desc: Savoury cake of eggs, flour, milk, bacon, chard and prunes, eaten hot or cold. A traditional peasant dish of Auvergne.

dishes.name: Saint-Nectaire
dishes.desc: Mild, fairly flavourful cow's milk cheese of the Auvergne volcanoes, served at home and in restaurants.

dishes.name: Auvergne pâtes de fruits
dishes.desc: Fruit jellies of apricot, apple, quince or plum, cooked, dried and rolled in sugar. An Auvergne tradition with a confectioner near Clermont-Ferrand.

dishes.name: Pompe aux pommes
dishes.desc: Rectangular apple tart with well-cooked pieces of apple, often served with vanilla ice cream. A regional bakery sweet of Auvergne.
